items.heading: Attieke with Grilled Fish
details: Key ingredients: cassava couscous, fish, tomato, onion
Steam grated fermented cassava (attieke) until light and fluffy.
Season and grill a whole fish until charred and cooked through.
Prepare a simple tomato and onion relish.
Serve the attieke with the grilled fish and relish.

items.heading: Kedjenou
details: Key ingredients: chicken, tomato, eggplant, ginger
Combine chicken with tomato, eggplant, ginger and spices in a sealed pot.
Cook over low heat without opening the lid, shaking occasionally.
Steam-braise slowly until the chicken is tender and the vegetables have melded.
